title: 3D dice for the whole table
summary: In shared campaigns, the Dungeon Master's screen and the TV / player display now throw players' rolls as they arrive, landing on exactly what was recorded.
items: The DM's screen throws each player's roll within a couple of seconds; opening a campaign never replays old rolls.
A connected TV / player display throws players' rolls for visible characters travelling with the party, and nothing while the display is blanked. The DM's own rolls stay on the DM's screen.
Players still see only their own rolls live.
Turn 3D dice off in Settings → Roll mode.
